children: CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) is biased to break a resistance at $13.23-1/4 per bushel and rise to the September 10 high of $13.35-1/4.
The strong rise from around the support at $12.95 is presumed to be riding on a wave (5), the fifth wave of an uptrend from $11.65.
This wave is capable of travelling to or far above $13.35-1/4. A failure to break $13.23-1/4 could trigger a drop to $13.10-1/4.
A further drop would cast doubt on the current bullish wave count. On the daily chart, the contract has broken a resistance at $13.19-1/4.
The break opened the way toward the $13.31-1/4 to $13.51 range.
